effect.en: Raises the user’s Special Defense by one stage.  User’s Electric moves have doubled power next turn.

flavor.en: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
flavor.ko: 다음 턴에 쓸 전기타입 기술의 위력을 올린다. 자신의 특수방어도 올라간다.
